retrievalProfile.description: A gritty urban layout featuring a central ornate sword icon framed by aggressive stencil and block typography within a structured blue border system.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dark, symmetrical composition dominated by a central ornate silver sword with a jagged blade, set against a glowing blue abstract wing-like shape. The design is framed by a thin blue double-border and utilizes heavy, industrial stencil-style typography for the primary title and condensed sans-serifs for secondary information.
coreVisualRelationships: Central vertical axis defined by the sword
Horizontal typographic bands anchoring the top and bottom
Contrast between metallic silver textures and flat electric blue
Symmetrical framing using thin linear borders
coreInvariants: Ornate gothic sword as the focal point

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The sword is centered vertically and horizontally, occupying the middle third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, metallic stencil title at the top serves as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down vertical flow, starting at the bold title, moving through the central sword, and ending at the stacked text blocks at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of black negative space to emphasize the glowing blue elements and metallic textures.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between deep black and high-value silver/blue highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses heavy, slab-like stencil cuts
Secondary text uses ultra-condensed, rounded-corner sans-serif
Uniform stroke weights within each hierarchy level
characterSpecificRedesigns: Stencil gaps are placed at consistent vertical midpoints
Condensed letters have flat tops and bottoms to maximize height
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Industrial stencil for impact paired with ultra-condensed sans-serif for information density.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy industrial stencil look of the main title
Matches the narrow, square-ish proportions of the secondary text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid black background with a thin electric blue double-line border. In the center, place a highly detailed silver gothic sword with a jagged blade and ornate hilt. Behind the sword, add a vibrant electric blue glow in an abstract wing or shield shape.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large metallic-textured stencil title at the top between two blue horizontal bars. Place ultra-condensed white sans-serif text in the bottom third, organized into stacked horizontal blocks separated by thin white lines.

verificationChecks: Does the main title have a brushed metal texture?

adjustableVariables: Number of text blocks at the bottom

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp line work in borders

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the blue is 'electric' and not navy or sky blue.
Check that the stencil gaps in the title are clearly visible.
Verify the sword blade has a distinct jagged/serrated edge.
Confirm the layout remains strictly symmetrical.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central ornate weapon + glowing abstract backing + heavy stencil header + condensed info footer + thin linear framing.
